title: Changing the part a received vendor bill line points to skips inactive parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
  • Have a received vendor bill, bill A, with one line for a vendor part.
  • Start on bill A (Parts in the top bar, Vendor Invoices in the left menu, then bill A).
custom_steps:
1. Click the control on the line that changes which part it points to.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in its part lookup.
  3. Close the lookup without picking anything.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A part lookup opens for the line.

Step 2:

  • Part B is offered and part A is not.

Step 3:

  • The line still points to its vendor part.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)
